name: Tucson Tabernacle
notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. Address 2555 N Stone Ave, Tucson AZ 85705 confirmed on the church's own site and repeated in its YouTube channel description; coordinates left as previously seeded 'approximate' since the address did not change. Pastor confirmed: Daniel Evans, pastor since 2023, listed on the contact page as the only named staff member (pastor@tucsontabernacle.com). The church was founded in 1965 by Rev. Pearry Green, who pastored it for almost 50 years until his death on 2015-08-20; an older legacy site survives at france30.tucsontabernacle.org. Services Sunday 10 AM and 5 PM, Wednesday 7 PM. The YouTube handle is @TucsonTabernacle (channel id UCABkSTBahwUU05ofDgir0FQ); note the sermons are on the Live/streams tab, not the Videos tab. Titles name the speaker, and besides Daniel Evans (clearly the main expositor, currently working through Matthew) the streams show recurring lay/visiting preachers Lyle Johnson, Bruce Carlson, Josiah Aho and Aaron Guerra. None of those four appear anywhere on the church website as staff, so they were NOT added as pastors - if a reviewer wants them included, confirm their role with the church first. Note also a staging copy of the site at dev01.tucsontabernacle.com; use the www domain.
